evidenceContract.userBehavior: Request one named durable Markdown plan from a Workspace conversation while retaining a concise ordinary chat summary.

observables.description: Terminal turn, summary-only final answer, exact Workspace Board projection, and terminal idle facts.
At least one durable Markdown file exists under the canonical generated file directory.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The Agent emits ordinary Markdown with one admitted document section; the Host publishes only that section, projects one Markdown file reference, and leaves only the concise summary in the conversation.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Whole-response JSON, a visible wire marker or document body in the final chat, missing durable Markdown, missing Board projection, or a non-idle turn fails.

steps.prompt: Create a named, durable, reviewable Markdown document titled Release Readiness Plan. Its document body must include a Risks section and a Verification section. In the ordinary conversation reply, summarize completion with the exact token ARTIFACT_READY.
